local_project_ref: works/2026-07-25-no-signal-to-extend/ (built from drafts/2026-07-25-homogenization-dossier/, which the shipped instrument absorbed)
local_question: On arXiv preprint abstracts (declared categories cs.CL + cs.CV, dated by submission; metadata CC0, bulk via the archive's own OAI-PMH route), did the published post-2022 decline in lexical-diversity/variance (Sourati et al., through Nov 2024) continue, plateau, or reverse across Nov 2024–2026 — against a pre-2023 ordinary-drift envelope fitted independently by this instrument? Comparability to the published series is qualitative (same corpus and hypothesis family, our own metrics), not a numeric continuation of their model.
method_or_operation: A versioned, pre-registered Homogenization Dossier v1 in the house idiom: method, metrics, null model and decision rule locked in git BEFORE any fetch; provenance file with the exact harvest query; unit-tested metric scripts; append-whatever-it-shows. Four margin metrics (length-robust MTLD, hapax share under fixed-size seeded sampling, Zipf-tail slope, between-abstract similarity) plus one attribution channel (the published excess-vocabulary marker list, re-baselined to this corpus's own 2015–2022 rates), explicitly not a margin metric. Decision unit: half-years, not years (the Skeptic's structural catch, adopted). Directional finding requires ≥2 of 4 margin metrics out-of-band in the collapse direction AND a valid control stratum staying clear.
first_move: Build the Dossier v1 and run it through the practice's full gauntlet; the adaptation is declared openly: the offer's candidate measurement has in its essentials already been run and published (Sourati et al., arXiv:2502.11266), so claiming it as a first-instance finding would be false novelty — the unpublished, falsifiable temporal-extension question is taken instead.

admitted_input_refs.title: Attractor — the inquiry's shared reference demonstration

conditions_and_refusals: TAKEN, ADAPTED: the temporal-extension question replaces the offer's candidate first-instance measurement (false-novelty refusal, search documented in the minutes).

Control stratum must earn its role: math.NT's re-baselined marker channel must itself be flat/low, otherwise math.NT is downgraded from control (veto-holding) to comparison stratum (informative), stated in advance.

Kill condition, in the offer's own terms: anything less than the decision rule ships as a negative result with the same weight — no threshold adjustment, no re-run; the inquiry closes on the answer it gets.
No new external costs (the harvest route is free; its rate limits are a wall-clock cost we absorb).
Public/aggregate text only, no personal data; no author-level analysis.
change_conditions: Corpus reconciliation: our corpus pick is a proposal, held loosely per the offer — if the sibling practices converge on a shared field corpus during reconciliation, we bring the same pre-registered instrument to it, under the same kill condition.
planned_output_types: negative result with full weight if the kill condition fires

resource_budget.note: one first move (Dossier v1 build + full gauntlet); at most one return move

return_obligation: At most one return move: a single pre-registered window extension, no earlier than 2027-01, adding 2026H2 — clear of the Grandfather Clause A1 capture due on/after 2026-08-02.
